title: One docs-only combine of five waiting PRs may be hand-built and timed from ready to merge
ruling: Owner 20:15 CST Nov 14, in chat, picked a on page item 848 (pick-hand-built-docs-combine), relayed by the consultant at 20:16 CST: "i enver ruled against by hand PRs like that i thought but anyways A". Covers the act option a names: lane g1 hand-builds one combined PR of #3396, #3431, #3428, #3391 and #3430 (all docs-only; the tool's dry fold read them clean) and the combine is timed from the ready mark to the merge, as the first measured number for the train. Standing rule added 20:22 CST Nov 14 (owner, 'Obey consultant please', on the consultant's 20:22 request, which read his 20:18 words 'Nothing can't be undone don't wait on me' as the licence): a hand-built combine of clean, reviewed lanes whose train-tool dry fold is clean needs no owner question. The standing scope is the consultant's reading, which the owner told sessions to obey; it is not his own sentence. It covers the named act (a hand-built combine of reviewed lanes with a clean dry fold) and no variant: not a combine that touches a guard or check, not a red or unreviewed lane, not a widening of a shared tool. The first grant (the five PRs above) is unchanged. The owner also said he never ruled against hand-built PRs like that; see the rewrite of own-826-a-now-build-b. Home: step combine-train-tool. RETIRED 19:50 CST Nov 15, no replacement (rewritten in place, rule git-one-record-per-question; the text above is kept): owner saved item 895 "none of these" with the note "this question is stale message consultant" (page save 19:48 CST Nov 15, as relayed by the coordinator; triage did not read the save). Consultant's read 19:50 CST, his and not the owner's: moot under own-merge-on-lint-pass (18:21) and own-merge-or-hand-off-by-speed (18:24); a combine stays optional whenever it lands faster. Status is closed, the store's only retired form (open or closed).
